docs.summary:
Logs `message` the first time this `id` is seen, then stays quiet however often it recurs. Ids are cleared when play mode changes and when scripts reload, so a condition you have just fixed reports again on the next run rather than staying silent.

Use a stable, specific id: `"MeshCollider.RelativeRebuild"`, not the message text.

members.name: EnsureMainThread
members.signature: public static bool EnsureMainThread(string member = "")

docs.summary:
Reports when a main-thread-only API is called from somewhere else, and says whether it was. Deduplicated per caller, because an offending call site usually repeats every frame.

The point is to fail where the rule was broken. Touching scene or engine state off-thread usually surfaces as a corrupted read or a crash somewhere unrelated, long after the call that caused it. Callers that can bail should act on the result; the rest at least get a name.

Always true before a [`MainThreadContext`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Tasks.MainThreadContext) is installed (tests, tools, early startup), since there is no engine thread to be off.
docs.returns: True when the caller is on the main thread.
